summary: Learn process discovery, conformance checking, and KPI dashboards in 5 days. Build practical tools for better operations decisions.
lede: Process mining and operational analytics turns event logs, audit trails, service timestamps, and workflow records into evidence of how work actually moves. This course helps you discover process maps, compare process variants, identify bottlenecks and rework, and assess conformance, throughput, cycle time, and SLA adherence. You will work with methods and tools including process discovery, PM4Py concepts, Power BI, root-cause analysis, SIPOC, Pareto analysis, and control charts. The training also introduces AI-assisted anomaly detection, conformance scoring, and low-code exception handling for teams working with fragmented systems, inconsistent timestamps, and limited analyst time.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to investigate how work really moves through systems, teams, and controls, then turn that evidence into action.
audience: Continuous Improvement Managers using Lean Six Sigma
prerequisites: Participants should have a working understanding of operational processes, KPI reporting, and basic spreadsheet analysis. Prior exposure to process mapping, business analytics, or workflow data is helpful, but no programming is required for completion; advanced analytics topics are taught at an operational application level, not technical engineering depth. If your organization can provide sample event-log extracts, process maps, KPI dashboards, or anonymized workflow reports, those will strengthen the hands-on exercises.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
